svg.aria-label: Engram: several AI agents write into one local knowledge base over MCP. By day each record gets a vector and links itself to similar nearest neighbours, skipping weak matches; an explicit correction supersedes the old version with its provenance and the old one goes to history; reads return the current version. By night the idle library consolidates itself: it replays and strengthens used paths, merges look-alike records, lets cold ones fade, and rewires a better link.
